text_block_list.text:
Having seized 1st place on the final stage 
of the Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka 
Sho, King Halo calls her mother while her 
excitement has yet to cool down.

This time, her mother would surely 
acknowledge her— Yet, her mother's words 
were merely superficial, never truly 
accepting her daughter from the heart.

Even the cheers from the crowd and staff 
merely echoed, "As expected of that 
mother's daughter." King Halo agonized 
over a reality far from what she desired.

The next day, King Halo asks her Trainer: 
Are you ready to cast everything aside? It 
was a conclusion she had reached through 
careful deliberation.
